units.source_text: “不算什么接待，我是给他们当翻译跑跑腿，

en.t: It is not really much of a reception; I am just acting as their interpreter and running errands,

units.source_text: 因为那位担任翻译的朋友，他妹妹去世了，我替他干三四天。”

en.t: because the friend who was supposed to serve as interpreter had a sister pass away, so I am filling in for him for three or four days.
